appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'River Temperature Monitoring Record'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Water temperature (°C)' with tick marks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with tick marks for the years 2005 through 2014.
A blue line connects data points for each year from 2005 to 2014.
Each data point is marked with a black dot and has its temperature value labeled directly above it.
The data point for 2005 is at 23.9°C and is the highest point on the chart.
The data point for 2014 is at 10.1°C and is the lowest point on the chart.
The line shows a clear downward trend from 2005 to 2014.

public_definitions: The task is to review the river temperature dashboard for the 2005-2014 review period.
The goal is to determine whether the full-period change requires substantial-change follow-up.
The decision must be submitted as one of three options: substantial-change follow-up, routine monitoring, or archive.
